selected_problem: Canonical truth-boundary evidence is HEAD-bound, but `_probe_workspace` still derives closed-capability existence and source-marker checks from the mutable working tree. Dirty deletion can reopen an already-committed capability and dirty addition/edit can fabricate closure that canonical main does not contain, steering autonomous diagnosis away from fresh-main code reality.

execution.route_basis: Fresh canonical main exposes one narrow continuation of the observation-authority invariant documented by the latest evidence. The defect is local to closed-capability probes, directly falsifiable, and high-centrality for autonomous candidate selection, so source-contract replay routes to DEEP_DEVELOPMENT without forced mode rotation.

changes: Closed-capability source existence and marker checks now read the canonical HEAD blob when a Git HEAD exists.
Dirty deletion or editing of committed capability source cannot reopen a capability that canonical main already contains.
Dirty addition of source absent from canonical HEAD cannot fabricate capability closure; non-Git workspaces retain filesystem fallback semantics.

validation.pre_fix_reproduction: REPRODUCED on prior canonical-main logic: focused regression 0/2 PASS. Dirty deletion made committed terminal/Git capabilities appear open; dirty addition made capabilities absent from HEAD appear closed.

truth_boundaries: Canonical HEAD authority now covers evidence discovery, evidence bytes, and closed-capability source probes, but the bridge still trusts Git HEAD provenance rather than proving semantic correctness of committed claims.
Non-Git workspace fallback necessarily observes mutable filesystem reality because no canonical revision exists.
BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: GitHub's merge REST endpoint still lacks an atomic expected-base-SHA precondition, so external GET-to-PUT base races remain outside client-side elimination.
